calls.video_title: Sold Out Until 2029. The Stock Is Still Falling.
calls.thesis: First tracked MarketBeat DELL call. Downey bullish on Dell as an AI server/storage cornerstone after a huge beat-and-raise: Q3 guidance EPS $6.50 and revenue $49bn vs Street ~$41bn, forward P/E ~17x (cheaper than the market); sellers are 'selling great companies' into the AI sell-off.
calls.base_case: Full-year FY27 guidance also beat and raised; infrastructure business (servers, storage, networking) is firing on all cylinders.
